name: Coyote Trader
teaser: Coyote is a new task focused trader that adds 68 new quests for you to complete.
description_html:
**REQUIRES VCQL MOD. THIS MOD WILL NOT FUNCTION WITHOUT VCQL!! DOWNLOAD HERE: Virtual’s Custom Quest Loader**UPDATE

vv

In the quest “Taking Mid Control” the requirement says “Eliminate PMCs on the main road”. It should read: “Eliminate PMCs on the main road with any AKM variant”. Will be fixed in next update.

Coyote is a new task focused trader that adds 68 new quests for you to complete.

Coyote is compatible with 3.8+ versions.

What is Coyote?

Inspired by the HEAT (1995) film, he is a trader primarily focused on giving tasks for the map Ground Zero and Labs. He currently has 68 fully functional quests.

Why Ground Zero?

There seems to be a criminal lack of tasks for GZ. Ground Zero is my favorite map because it’s the most urban map with the best performance, simple to learn and fun to play. Since writing this I also added some Labs quests because I started running labs like crazy and it’s been fun so YEAH.

What does he sell? Any new custom items?

Currently there is a small selection of items that he sells. (See item stock below) There are no plans to implement new items into the game at this moment.

Notable items in stock:

Blue Fuel [LL2] ($1010)

Grenade Case [LL2] ($2100)

Holodilnick [LL2] ($2220)

THICC Case [LL3] ($96000)

Money Case [LL3] ($2700)

Junk Box [LL3] ($7000)

Weapon Case [LL4] ($28000)

Keycard Holder [LL4] ($1650)

Keytool [LL4] ($3300)

I tried adding weapons into the shop but was running into problems. (skill issue) They might appear in a future update. If anyone wants to take a look at the code and help me out that would be sick.

Level 4 is supposed to be a serious grind only accessed by the most dedicated questers.

How do I install?

After installing VCQL (see link above), using 7zip, drag and drop the “user” folder from CoyoteTrader zip into your SPT directory.

Known bugs/issues:

Quests where you use a MS2000 Marker use the LeaveItemAtLocation condition instead of PlaceBeacon. Not a problem just a footnote.

- In mission “Gymtimidation” subtask: Eliminate 10 Pmcs can be completed in other maps.

- In mission “The Heist Part 6” can be completed by turning in 5m roubles found in raid only.

In the quest “Taking Mid Control” the requirement says “Eliminate PMCs on the main road”. It should read: “Eliminate PMCs on the main road with any AKM variant”. Will be fixed in next update.

Besides the above… None at the moment. Please let me know in the comments if something is not working as intended. I have tested this mod with most other major mods besides realism.

Realism compatibility?

I do not play with realism and this mod has not been tested with it. I have no idea if it works with it or not and have no intention of adding compatibility patches for it without some help. (It should work but I always see comments about realism changing prices so the prices may not be balanced.)

Future plans?

More quests on more maps.

Trying to figure out the weapons store.

Better/more balanced rewards.

Improving localization.

Taking a break from racking my brain in VSCode.

Disclaimer

This is my first mod for SPT. As this mod is coded by an atomic smooth brain, I recommended to back up your profiles before installing this mod.

Special thanks to:

Shirito – for providing the template in which this mod was created.

SPT discord – a place to post my silly cries for help.

You – for downloading this mod.
